headline: Bangladesh observes Eid-e-Miladunnabi with national programs
summary: The country marks the birth and death anniversary of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) with religious solemnity and high security across the capital.
details: The holy Eid-e-Miladunnabi, commemorating the birth and death anniversary of Prophet Hazrat Muhammad (PBUH), is being observed across Bangladesh today with religious solemnity.
Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) was born in Makkah in 570 AD and passed away on the same day in 632 AD, bringing a message of peace for mankind.
The government has organized extensive national-level programs to mark the public holiday, including hoisting the national flag at government, semi-government, and private institutions.
President Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir and Prime Minister Tarique Rahman issued separate messages greeting Muslims worldwide.
The President also inaugurated the Islamic Foundation's fortnight-long 'Siratunnabi (PBUH) Programme' at the Baitul Mukarram National Mosque in Dhaka.
Special prayers are being offered at mosques nationwide, including the Bangladesh Secretariat Mosque, while Bangladesh missions abroad are also observing the day.
To ensure peace and order, the Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) has established a strict security ring in the capital, and the Rapid Action Battalion (RAB) remains alert across the country.

President Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir and Prime Minister Tarique Rahman issued separate messages greeting Muslims worldwide.

The President also inaugurated the Islamic Foundation's fortnight-long 'Siratunnabi (PBUH) Programme' at the Baitul Mukarram National Mosque in Dhaka.

Special prayers are being offered at mosques nationwide, including the Bangladesh Secretariat Mosque, while Bangladesh missions abroad are also observing the day.

To ensure peace and order, the Dhaka Metropolitan Police (DMP) has established a strict security ring in the capital, and the Rapid Action Battalion (RAB) remains alert across the country.

headline_marked: Funeral rites held for [[four members of a teacher's family killed]] in Rangpur
headline: Funeral rites held for four members of a teacher's family killed in Rangpur
summary: Family members and locals expressed deep anger and demanded a thorough investigation into the brutal killings as the city corporation administrator attended the rites.
details: Funeral rites for the four members of a teacher's family who were killed in Rangpur city were completed on Tuesday, August 25.
The rituals were held according to Hindu traditions at the victims' home in Machhuapara, where priests and relatives performed special prayers for the peace of the deceased.
The Rangpur City Corporation administrator, Mahfuz un Nabi Don, attended the rites and urged the public to provide any critical information to law enforcement agencies to help solve the case.
Despite the presence of officials, relatives and local residents expressed intense anger and demanded that the mystery behind the brutal murders be uncovered and the perpetrators brought to justice.
Administrator Mahfuz un Nabi Don called for patience, stating that law enforcement agencies need reasonable time to uncover the actual mystery of the killings.
He also warned residents to be cautious and not allow any individual or group to misrepresent the facts or use the incident for political purposes.
caption:
Funeral rites completed for the four members of a teacher's family killed in Rangpur. Family and locals demand justice.

Funeral rites for the four members of a teacher's family who were killed in Rangpur city were completed on Tuesday, August 25.

The rituals were held according to Hindu traditions at the victims' home in Machhuapara, where priests and relatives performed special prayers for the peace of the deceased.

The Rangpur City Corporation administrator, Mahfuz un Nabi Don, attended the rites and urged the public to provide any critical information to law enforcement agencies to help solve the case.

Despite the presence of officials, relatives and local residents expressed intense anger and demanded that the mystery behind the brutal murders be uncovered and the perpetrators brought to justice.

Administrator Mahfuz un Nabi Don called for patience, stating that law enforcement agencies need reasonable time to uncover the actual mystery of the killings.

He also warned residents to be cautious and not allow any individual or group to misrepresent the facts or use the incident for political purposes.

Source: Dhaka Tribune, Jamuna TV, The Daily Star
